intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. This page compares recorded fees, placements and NIRF ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.

Amity University Noida vs Jaypee Institute of Information Technology is a same-city private comparison. Amity Noida has the newer NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 37. JIIT has the only 2020 or later placement record on this page.

sections.heading: Amity University Noida vs Jaypee Institute of Information Technology for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amity University Noida if a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 37 matters most. JIIT's latest NIRF Engineering rank here is 101 from 2023.
Choose JIIT if you want the more recent placement record on this page. JIIT has 2023 figures here, while Amity Noida's latest recorded placement year is 2016, which we do not treat as current.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Amity University Noida has recorded B.Tech tuition of ₹2.27 lakh a year on this page. Treat that as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check Amity's current fee notice.

JIIT's raw rows include admission and application charges, development fees and other heads, as well as tuition. Those smaller rows, including an application fee of ₹1,200, are not the programme tuition. Confirm JIIT's official year or semester circular for the branch you will join.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: JIIT's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹11 lakh and a highest package of ₹82 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
Amity Noida's latest recorded row here is from 2016, with an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹18 lakh. Because 2016 is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result.
Ask Amity Noida for its latest official placement report. Do not compare a 2016 row with JIIT's 2023 figures as if they described the same year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both institutes list JEE Main on this page. Amity and JIIT also run their own admission processes for many programmes.
Class 12 PCM is the usual academic requirement. Read the current official admissions page of each institute for tests, cut-offs and scholarships.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, in the Delhi NCR belt. Amity Noida and JIIT are separate campuses in the same city.
Visit both if commute, hostel and the exact sector will decide the choice for you.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the newer NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, Amity University Noida at 37 stands above JIIT's 2023 rank of 101.
If you want a 2023 placement record on this page, JIIT is the side with current figures, at an average of ₹11 lakh and a highest of ₹82 lakh.
Do not use JIIT's application or development-fee rows as the programme tuition. Confirm both official fee circulars.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Amity University Noida or JIIT, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: Amity Noida has the newer NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 37, against JIIT's 2023 rank of 101. JIIT has the only 2020 or later placement record on this page, from 2023, with a ₹11 lakh average and an ₹82 lakh highest package.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for Amity Noida vs JIIT?
faqs.answer: Amity Noida's recorded tuition is ₹2.27 lakh a year. JIIT has several fee heads in our records, including small admission and application charges that are not the programme tuition. Confirm JIIT's official circular for the branch you will join.

faqs.question: Do both institutes accept JEE Main?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both list JEE Main on this page. Each may also use its own admission process. Check the current official admissions pages.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Amity Noida and JIIT?
faqs.answer: JIIT's recorded 2023 average is ₹11 lakh and the highest is ₹82 lakh. Amity Noida's latest recorded year here is 2016, which this page does not treat as a current flagship result.

faqs.question: Are Amity Noida and JIIT in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, on different campuses in the Delhi NCR belt.
